answer_text_requirements.requirement: answer_text is a string after strict outer-schema parsing
answer_text is non-empty after Unicode whitespace trimming
answer_text contains at least one Unicode alphabetic character
answer_text is not solely punctuation, braces, brackets, quotes, or whitespace
answer_text does not itself parse as a JSON object or JSON array
answer_text is not a raw JSON-like evidence, Dashboard, Memory, or Planning serialization
answer_text is not a serialized internal structure containing frozen internal field keys
answer_text can be displayed directly to a student as ordinary prose or Markdown

character_count_definition: Python Unicode code-point count of answer_text before trimming
minimum_length_policy: No minimum response length is imposed beyond excluding punctuation-only, structurally empty, or otherwise non-student-facing responses.
word_count_definition: Count of Unicode word tokens matched by the deterministic regular expression \b\w+\b before trimming
